'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Jesper Gravesen LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jesper Gravesen]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jesper Gravesen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open QMC Gravesen LS 2015 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
